error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Philips Avent servers
error.tuya_error: Login failed. Tuya reported: {error_code}. Enable debug logging and check the log for details, then report this code if the problem persists.

data_description.bridge_host: Where Home Assistant can reach the WebRTC bridge. Leave it as localhost when you use the add-on; set the container name or IP address if you run the bridge yourself, elsewhere.
data_description.bridge_port: Port the WebRTC bridge listens on (default: 38554)
data_description.talkback: Leave this off unless a client of yours actually talks back through the stream. Asking the camera for two-way audio makes the monitor stop a playing lullaby and restart it from the beginning when you close the stream.
